scrapers.name: PinoyMoviesHub
scrapers.description: Pinoy movies & series from pinoymovieshub.win: direct pmh- slug lanes, and headerless-probe emission for Mixdrop/Dood direct links (TV-safe when the CDN allows; Byse stays first). v5.8.0: tolerant catalog-id parsing for the addon's new episode ids (asian:pmh-<slug>:<s>:<e>) so every pmh series episode tap keeps its season/episode even when the app passes no args.
